name: Homura Minatsu
source:
Although she has a youthful physique and appearance, she is a full-fledged third-year student.

While she has a quiet personality, she is inflexible; she searches for any breach of public morals within the school and, even for the most trivial matters, will pout her lips and firmly call them out while looking up at you.

Having witnessed a portion of the protagonist's misdeeds, she is now stealthily monitoring him in her capacity as a disciplinary committee member, plotting a way to drive him out and prevent any further trouble.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1361154]Getchu[/url]]
